name: agent-safety
skills: Security of AI agents that read untrusted text: prompt injection in documents and pages, data leaks through links and images, hidden Unicode, unsafe code in answers, SSRF in URL fetchers, cost abuse.
examples: How can my agent leak a user's data through a link in its answer?
Which invisible characters should I strip before a model reads untrusted text?
How do I let my agent fetch URLs without exposing my internal network?
